claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Pefloxacin is a fluoroquinolone antibacterial with weak human topoisomerase II (TOP2A) inhibition; at 2.5 uM in 5-day pooled human cancer cell line screens it is expected to produce little or no selective cytotoxicity, since its antibacterial activity requires bacterial gyrase/ParC and concentrations needed for human topoisomerase poisoning are far higher.
